---
title: "بقیعہ سے آ رہی ہے صدا"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Noha"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false

Baqiya se ah rahi hai zahra ki yeh sada

1
Ab tak bhi haath baba pehloo peh hai mera

2
Darbar mein kari hai leke gawaha apne
Tukre sanad ke kar ke haste hai behaya

3
Kehte hai kalma gowo darbar mein kari hai
Tazeem jiski karne uthe teh mustafa

4
Deke fidak ka sadka zahra bata gayi hai
Hai khon dene wala aur khon heh gadah

5
Dastar teri beji mujhse fidak hai cheena
Abh ban mein kar diya hai zainab ko berida

6
Zahra teri nasal neh tawheed hai bachai
Tere laal ne he karbal sajde mein sar diya

7
Zahra tere katal di bunyad hai sakeefa
Yasrab hai ab bhi shahid tareekh hai gawah

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
s = Path('src/data/lyrics/baqiya-se-aa-rahi-hai-sada.md').read_text()
_, front, body = s.split('---\\n', 2)
roman = front.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1]
counts = lambda v: [len(b.splitlines()) for b in v.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
assert counts(roman) == counts(body) == [1, 2, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3]
assert [l for l in body.splitlines() if l.isdecimal()] == list('۱۲۳۴۵۶۷')
assert all(not l or l.startswith('  ') for l in roman.splitlines())
print('Verified opening and seven aligned stanzas.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed the Urdu body in [baqiya-se-aa-rahi-hai-sada.md](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/workspaces/402fbd33997c49359a106df5d7964499/src/data/lyrics/baqiya-se-aa-rahi-hai-sada.md) and moved the Roman transcription into `romanLyrics`, adjusting capitalization only. Verified that the opening and all seven stanzas align verse by verse. Set the direction to RTL, added the Roman title, and removed `noUrdu`.

I read `kalma gowo` as `کلمہ گو وہ` and `khon` as `کون` in both occurrences.
